mapper.select: SELECT user_id, real_review_clicked_at FROM review_guide_user_state WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_guide_exposure (user_id, scene, guide_type, shown_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{scene}, #{guideType}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE review_guide_user_state SET real_review_clicked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND real_review_clicked_at IS NULL
UPDATE review_guide_exposure SET in_app_rating = COALESCE(in_app_rating, #{rating}), feedback_at = COALESCE(feedback_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE id = #{id}
